body:
**Seat registration — `domain:devx` @ `objectui`, seat 2.** Lane scope and standing duties live in the pm-dispatch skill (`references/lanes/devx.md` in objectstack). This post carries current state only. Readers: body + comments later than the body's last edit. Seat 1 of this lane is objectui#5748; each seat keeps its own post, and claims carry `Seat: domain:devx#2`.

## 1 · Current PM

- **⏳ vacant since 2026-09-28T14:58Z.** The shift closed on the maintainer's instruction 「当前任务处理完，合并后就下班」. The shift-close brief is the last comment on this post.
- Previous PM: session `session_01EBx9rvB7dufCz4at53x35U`, account `huangyiirene`, seated 2026-09-28 on the maintainer's summons (`/pm-dispatch devx@objectui`, 「你是本车道的第2个座位」).
- In flight: **0**. ⛔ No stay-behind: every card this seat claimed has landed or been disposed of, and this session keeps no timers on this seat.
- To take the seat: `/pm-dispatch devx@objectui`, then read this post's body and the brief first.

**Decision box:** empty for this lane.

**Filed this shift and awaiting triage:**
- objectui#10979 (`finding`): 11 PUBLISHING pending changesets state a present-tense repo count that is false on `main`, and each ships into a CHANGELOG at the next release. It matters only if it lands before the release PR objectui#5400 merges.
- objectui#10931 (graded p2, above).

**Same-family follow-ups from objectui#9520's contract review (`5871279884` ③).** Recorded here as promised in PR #10984's 速读; no card was filed.
- `content/docs/guide/ci-cd-pipeline.md`, the header of `scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` and the header of `.github/workflows/spec-main-shape-gate.yml` still describe the Governed Surface Queue Guard's enrolment conditionally (「Until it is flipped …」 / "not REQUIRED"). They are literally true but no longer current.
- `WATCHED_CONTEXTS` in `scripts/check-required-check-set.mjs` lacks that guard, so the daily patrol reports `drifted` (exit 0). The ruling record a change would cite now exists (objectui#6596 `5852208696`). The gate's header forbids editing the list to agree with the endpoint, so the change must cite that ruling.

Serial rows are a cache: re-measure `GET /pulls/{n}/files` over all open PRs at dispatch time, every time.

## 4 · Notes (standing facts this shift measured)

- **Release timing:** `changeset-release.yml` refreshes the version PR objectui#5400 only on the SCHEDULED lane; the push lane skips the release job. A pending-changeset fix reaches #5400 at the next scheduled fire.
- **Half-state channel:** there is no anchor (the maintainer declined it on 2026-09-09, objectui#7852 `5594845713`), so run `PM_SWEEP_REPO=objectstack-ai/objectui node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` on demand.
- **`Spec Main Shape Gate` breaks:** the maintainer's standing rule (objectui#10916 `5866275396`) gives the repair to any `domain:ui` seat as a stop-the-bleed. Today's second break (objectstack#20357) was anchored on objectui#10987 and fixed by PR #10992.
- **Channel note:** `PUT /pulls/{n}/update-branch` has no relay op, and direct calls author the merge commit as the linked user. Sync `main` into a branch through a dev's `git merge` with the model-free trailer pair.
- **Budget:** the trailing-hour write budget (40) was the binding constraint twice this shift. Order writes so a dev's PR, assign and report always have room.
